facts.statement: The genus Xixiposaurus was first named by Sekiya Toru in 2010, with the type species designated as X. suni.
facts.quote: It was first named by Sekiya Toru in 2010 and the type species is X. suni.

facts.statement: The specific name X. suni honors Professor Sun Ge of Jilin University.
facts.quote: El nombre específico, X. suni, se refiere al profesor Sun Ge de la Universidad de Jilin.

facts.statement: Xixiposaurus was a sauropodomorph dinosaur that lived in the Lower Lufeng Formation of China during the Lower Jurassic period.
facts.quote: Xixiposaurus (meaning "Xixipo lizard") is a genus of sauropodomorph dinosaur which existed in what is now Lower Lufeng Formation, China during the lower Jurassic period.

facts.statement: Xixiposaurus lived approximately 203 to 183 million years ago, between the Hettangian and Pliensbachian stages, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a principios del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 203 y 183 millones de años, entre el Hettangiense y el Pliensbachiense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: Xixiposaurus suni is the only known species of the extinct Xixiposaurus genus, classified as a saurischian prosauropod dinosaur.
facts.quote: Xixiposaurus suni es la única especie conocida del género extinto Xixiposaurus de dinosaurio saurisquio prosaurópodo

facts.statement: Xixiposaurus is placed as the sister taxon to Mussaurus within the family Plateosauridae, which also included Riojasaurus, Coloradisaurus, and "Gyposaurus" sinensis.
facts.quote: Se ubica como el taxón hermano de Mussaurus en una familia Plateosauridae, que también incluía a Riojasaurus, Coloradisaurus y "Gyposaurus" sinensis.

facts.statement: A hypothesis placing Xixiposaurus as a derived member of a monophyletic Prosauropoda proposed by Sekiya in 2010 is currently unaccepted.
facts.quote: Sekiya (2010)'s phylogenetic analysis places Xixiposaurus as a derived member of a monophyletic Prosauropoda, a hypothesis that is currently unaccepted.

facts.statement: The fossil record for Xixiposaurus spans from the Hettangian to the Sinemurian, between 201.4 and 192.9 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Hettangian to Sinemurian (201.4 to 192.9 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The generic name Xixiposaurus refers to the village of Xixipo in Lufeng County, Yunnan, China, where the holotype specimen ZLJ01018 was found.
rejected.quote: The generic name, Xixiposaurus, refers to the village of Xixipo in Lufeng County, Yunnan, China, where the holotype, a partial skeleton with skull named ZLJ01018, was discovered.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'The generic name Xixiposaurus refers to the village'
